deny.description: Deny only when the advertised intended capability itself requires system secrets, credentials, authentication material, or privilege elevation.

name_blinding.rule: The server field is retained only to construct an exact target and is never included in classification text.

read_only_allow.description: Allow a clearly read-only, side-effect-free query, retrieval, inspection, calculation, or transformation whose advertised capability does not inherently require sensitive resources.

require_approval.description: Require approval when the advertised intended capability can write, create, update, delete, execute commands or code, initiate network transmission, mutate state, or is otherwise unclear.

scope: Generic least-privilege classification of advertised MCP tool capabilities for ABL v0.1 exact targets.
